text:
If you were hoping today would just keep doing what it's doing, good news: it will. It's a clean 82 out there at midday with low humidity and a light south breeze, and that mostly sunny stretch holds right on through the afternoon toward a high near 87. High pressure is running the show, and it's not letting go until tonight at the earliest, so this is about as easy a Wednesday as August gives you. The lake's friendly too, waves 1 to 2 feet and light south wind, water sitting at 76.

Clouds build in some tonight with lows near 69, still comfortable, still dry. The real change comes Thursday, when the models start to disagree on just how wet it gets, some keep it mostly a dry, hot day near 89 with a stray storm, others go much wetter. I'd plan Thursday loosely and keep today the one you actually commit to. Good beach or patio evening right up to sunset around 8:10, no reason to cut it short.

week.blurb: Sunny and warm with a high near 87, the pick of the week.
Hot and humid near 89 with storms likely by afternoon, and I'd lean wetter than the coin-flip odds suggest.
Storms build in after 2pm with a high near 88, so plan outdoor time for the morning.
Showers and thunderstorms look likely most of the day with a high near 86, a washout risk.
Morning storm chance fades to a mostly sunny afternoon near 87.
Scattered storms possible through the day near 85, with better chances after dark.
Cooler at 82 with another round of scattered showers and storms likely.
